snippet.title: Adaptory | Early Access Release Announcement Date Trailer | indie.io
snippet.description:
Adaptory Lands into Early Access on January 26th! 
Wishlist & Follow on Steam ➤ https://store.steampowered.com/app/2201620/Adaptory/ 

Adaptory is a 2D base-building simulation game about surviving strange worlds, tuning complex systems, and keeping a small team together when everything wants to go wrong.

🪐 Explore ever-changing maps of ice, caves, plants & ancient structures
☄️ Face random events like meteor showers and solar flares
🏗️ Use limited resources to construct a thriving underground base
🔬 Unlock new tech and possibilities through research
🧑‍🚀 Manage each crew member’s strengths, stressors & relationships as they try to contact home

Keep them alive. Keep them together. Maybe even rebuild the ship.

Visit indie.io on Steam ➤ https://bit.ly/4e91q5q
#indiegames #cozygaming  #simulation #survival #steamgames
